scope.interaction: create and revoke one disposable pairing link, then cold restart

fixture.credentialPolicy: The one-time credential is never written to diagnostics, logs, tracked evidence, or this file.

productLoss: The create flow kept only the credential and expiry, discarding the created pairing link id.
After revoking that same link from its list row, the locally rendered one-time code remained visible and the action stayed Copy code even though the credential was invalid.
The fix stores the link id with the local credential and clears the local code only after successful revocation of that exact link.
